from: August book, night 2 (A Great Shout of Joy)
p1: Heavenly Father’s people were home in Jerusalem at last. They began to build the Lord’s house again. First they laid the foundation, the strong bottom part that holds it up.
Then the priests, who served in the Lord’s house, blew trumpets. Other helpers clanged cymbals.
They all sang together, “The Lord is good! His kindness lasts forever!”
p2: The people gave a great shout of joy! But some old men cried out loud. They remembered the first house of the Lord from long ago. The happy shouts and sad cries were so loud, people far away heard them.
Happy and sad can come together, and Heavenly Father understands both. Tonight, tell Him one happy thing and one sad thing from your day.
old: When the people reached home, the temple ground was just dirt and rubble. But they were not sad for long — they were ready to build Heavenly Father’s house!
First, they set up an altar so they could pray and worship together. Then the builders came with big, heavy stones to lay the very first layer, called the foundation.
When the foundation was finished, the people had a giant celebration! Trumpets played and cymbals crashed. Everyone sang, “Heavenly Father is so good; His love lasts forever!”

Something tender happened too. The oldest people remembered the very first temple, long ago, and happy tears rolled down their cheeks. So there was singing AND crying, all mixed together, and Heavenly Father saw every bit of it. Big feelings are welcome when we worship Him.
